newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese get dressing down on misuse of money.
newsitem.headline: Chinese get dressing down on misuse of money.

text.p: In China you can sell T-shirts to make money, but you can't use money to sell T-shirts.

China has banned entrepreneurs from using money to decorate T-shirts, baseball hats or any other products saying such acts damage the credibility of the currency, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
A decree issued by the State Council outlawed anyone from using the design of the yuan for decoration without approval from the central bank, it said.
Illegal trade in the yuan and the use of notes withdrawn from circulation without central bank permission were also forbidden, it said.
